# invoice-lint

Checks an invoice export before it goes to the payment run.

1. Every row needs invoice, vendor, po and amount.
2. Flag any row with an empty po.
3. Flag any row with an amount over 10,000.00.
4. Report the flagged invoice numbers and why.
